mapspam.zarr_open_strategy: download complete public S3 prefix to local cache, verify Zarr metadata, then open local Zarr with consolidated=False and explicit store-aligned chunks (Zarr auto-rechunking fails on object-dtype coordinate arrays)
supported_spatial_layouts: flattened cell dimension with x/y coordinates

country_boundaries.use: approximate country attribution, not a farm boundary

scientific_limitations: Sites are cultivated 5-arc-minute MAPSPAM grid cells, not surveyed individual farms.
MAPSPAM outcomes are spatially disaggregated estimates from administrative statistics.
SoilGrids is a modelled 250m prediction product, not laboratory measurement.
WoSIS nearest profile may not be from the sampled crop cell; distance is included.
The crop-presence label is observed allocated land use, not optimal crop suitability.
FAOSTAT fertilizer nutrient records are national statistics, not plot-level application records.
No global public source provides field-level irrigation, fertilizer application, farm costs, or rotation history for every site.
Missing values remain missing; they are not converted to zero.
